answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 59161 Country: India Title: My Sister Marriage Question: My father step sister's has a daughter & her son wants to marry my sister and I want to know is it possible or not in Islam. Answer ID: 59161 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 992/988/B=10/1436) Yes, this nikah is valid and lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
